hints.tr: `COUNT(*)` satırları sayıyor, `COUNT(sutun)` yalnızca o sütunu dolu olanları.
hints.en: `COUNT(*)` counts rows; `COUNT(column)` counts only the rows where that column is filled.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       COUNT(supplier_code) AS with_supplier,
       COUNT(DISTINCT category) AS distinct_categories
FROM products;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       COUNT(supplier_code) AS with_supplier,
       COUNT(DISTINCT category) AS distinct_categories
FROM products;
```
